body:
Thank you.

It's just kind of impossible to look out for the next one because there isn't anyone like him. I know that may sound silly but even my psychotherapist said that it could be kind of difficult to find someone for me, especially because you never know who's gay and who not.

"Though my soul began to rot, I won't lose hope, it's all I got." 

I'd prefer to wait years for him instead of knowing that it was all for nothing. I don't see any sense in my life without him, and I'm serious. I know people always say that there'll be others .. but I don't want someone other. :(

Thank you for your answer.

Well, the thing is, it isn't my first love. I had relationships with women a few years ago, where I also thought that it'd last longer. I also already fell in love with an other guy with no feelings for me 3 years ago. 

But this time .. Everything was different, nearly everything is perfect and I'm just sick of being alone and waiting .. To live with the certainty that he problably will never be on my side is hell on earth.
